name: Steam Tools
description: A hub for your Steam library. Price Tracker lists every game you own and charts its real Steam price history over 1D, 1W, 1M, 6M, 1Y and 5Y — years of it, sourced from IsThereAnyDeal, plus the all-time low. Open a game for its banner, current price and discount, description, tags and full PC system requirements. Your Steam key stays encrypted on this device and goes only to Steam; price history is read through the luma server with your account, so there is no second key to find or paste in.
